open_points.subject: credential detection in service-returned files
open_points.text: “A service's own answer body that echoes one verbatim is withheld from everyone …; one that carries it … inside a file the kernel only moves, cannot be recognised” contradicts A09 rule 7: “Every body as read, whatever its status … is searched … for the bytes of the credential value sent with the request.”
open_points.question: When a service response is a file containing the credential bytes verbatim, must the service invoker scan and withhold it, or treat file contents as uninspected and protect them only by disclosure class?
options: Scan every response body, including file outputs, and withhold a verbatim match
Do not inspect file response bodies; spool them and rely on their disclosure class
open_points.default_guess: Follow the detailed A09 invocation rule: scan file response bodies and withhold a verbatim credential match.
